hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Transitional—reporting obligations of the Future Fund Board of Guardians

content.p: Despite the repeal of sections 113 and 114 (reporting obligations) of the Nation-building Funds Act 2008 by this Schedule, those sections continue to apply, after the commencement of this item, in relation to:
the performance of the Future Fund Board of Guardians’ functions; and
in respect of the repealed Building Australia Fund, as if the repeal of those sections had not happened.

Despite the amendments of section 81 of the Future Fund Act 2006 made by this Schedule, that section continues to apply, in relation to the annual report for the period in which this item commences, as if those amendments had not been made.

The Minister may, by legislative instrument, make rules prescribing matters of a transitional nature (including prescribing any saving or application provisions) relating to the amendments or repeals made by this Schedule.
However, to avoid doubt, the rules may not do the following:
create an offence or civil penalty;
set an amount to be appropriated from the Consolidated Revenue Fund under an appropriation in this Act;
directly amend the text of this Act.
